## Radius two: 39 held, two live relays

Every radius-two contact has an independently emitted middle cell. Thirty-five
middle cells are known, six unknown, two are strict-head forms, and none is
another target. No three-cell frame repeats exactly.

Thirty-nine contacts therefore become discovery-only. Two remain explicit
working relay hypotheses after manual line inspection:

- `qokeey–okeey–lain` keeps **interner Heißgrad II** because the middle field
  continues the hot axis;
- `pcheol–sholoiin–cthor` keeps **Status-Eintrag des Materials; Zustandsachse
  offen** because the middle field continues the broad carrier.

These are not “proven exceptions.” They are the two best semantic-relay ideas
and are labeled as such until a better frame model replaces them.
